name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2178: A safety interlock with no expiry is a permanent lock. nothing_in_flight refuses a relaunch while a chronicle sweep is reading, and that is correct, because relaunching mid-read throws away reads he paid for. But running had no ceiling, and the hunt loop fixed in v2176 made running true forever. So the build that stops the loop could never be installed, because the loop itself was holding the door shut against it. Measured live at the moment I looked: phase hunting, elapsed 4263319 ms which is 71 minutes, ten held names, and a relaunch banner he could not act on because v2177 had not shipped yet and its button was 94 percent off the right edge of his window. Two independent locks on the same door, and he had been reporting both for hours in the only words available to him, which were i cant relaunch and when the hell is it gonna stop. The refusal now expires at a 45 minute ceiling and says so out loud with the elapsed time, because a guard that stands down in silence is indistinguishable from one that never ran. The ceiling is asserted from both sides so it can never become a threshold above its own signal: above a long but honest sweep, and below the runaway actually observed. And because a long sweep can now be interrupted, the hunt banks its empty record after each ledger rather than only at the end, so being cut off mid sets hunt cannot throw away what the uniques hunt already paid for. The general shape worth carrying: when the condition a guard waits for can be produced forever by a defect, that guard becomes the shield of the defect.
